mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 57 degrees with mainly clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a First Quarter moon overhead.

The city is currently working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which is upgrading water and sewer lines and adding new sidewalks. Additionally, residents can look forward to future street rehabilitation projects in 2026 for areas like Gateway Pass and Bering Drive.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company.
On Friday, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found passed out in her vehicle at the intersection of North Main Street and Cross Country Road.

Today's featured flavor is Double Strawberry, but since the store is currently closed, you will have to wait until they open at 10 AM to grab a dish. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Heath Crunch.
